name: mapleclear-extension
description: MapleClear browser extension for simplifying government webpages

scripts.build: tsc && vite build && npm run build:post && npm run build:deps
scripts.build:deps: cp src/manifest.json dist/ && cp src/content-styles.css dist/ && cp src/browser-polyfill.js dist/ && cp src/popup.js dist/ && cp src/panel.js dist/
scripts.build:post: mv dist/src/popup.html dist/ && mv dist/src/panel.html dist/ && rmdir dist/src || true
